H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AAs='ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVBZX'

IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,22) for c in s],dtype=int)
G=-8.0
def nw_linear(e1,e2):
    n,m=len(e1),len(e2); S=MAT[np.ix_(e1,e2)]
    Hm=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9); Hm[0,0]=0; ar=np.arange(m+1,dtype=float); Hm[0,1:]=G*ar[1:]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        H0=np.empty(m+1); H0[0]=G*i
        H0[1:]=np.maximum(Hm[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1], Hm[i-1,1:]+G)
        Hm[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(H0-G*ar)+G*ar
    i,j=n,m; pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        h=Hm[i,j]
        if abs(h-(Hm[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-6: pr.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif abs(h-(Hm[i-1,j]+G))<1e-6: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
recs=json.loads(requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream',
    params={'query':'xref:pfam-PF30387','format':'json','fields':'accession,organism_name,lineage,sequence,ft_signal'},
    headers=H,timeout=300).text)['results']
rows=[]
for r in recs:
    lin=[t['scientificName'] for t in r.get('lineages',[])]
    king='Fungi' if 'Fungi' in lin else ('Bacteria' if 'Bacteria' in lin else 'other')
    sig=any(f['type']=='Signal' for f in r.get('features',[]))
    rows.append(dict(acc=r['primaryAccession'],org=r['organism']['scientificName'],king=king,
                     seq=r['sequence']['value'],signal=sig))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df['genus']=df.org.str.split().str[0]; df['L']=df.seq.str.len()
print('UniProt automatic signal-peptide annotation among PF30387 members:')
print(df.groupby('king').signal.agg(['sum','count','mean']))
sub=df[(df.L>=300)&(df.L<=700)].sort_values('L').groupby(['king','genus'],as_index=False).first()
fung=sub[sub.king=='Fungi'].sample(n=min(120,(sub.king=='Fungi').sum()),random_state=1)
bact=sub[sub.king=='Bacteria'].sample(n=min(60,(sub.king=='Bacteria').sum()),random_state=1)
sel=pd.concat([fung,bact])
Q=''.join(requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q6FWH9.fasta',headers=H,timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
eQ=enc(Q)
colsF=collections.defaultdict(list); colsB=collections.defaultdict(list)
for _,r in sel.iterrows():
    pr=nw_linear(eQ,enc(r.seq))
    tgt=colsF if r.king=='Fungi' else colsB
    for i,j in pr: tgt[i+1].append(r.seq[j])
allc={p:colsF.get(p,[])+colsB.get(p,[]) for p in set(list(colsF)+list(colsB))}
def frac(c,p): 
    v=c.get(p,[]); return (v.count(Q[p-1])/len(v), len(v)) if v else (np.nan,0)
CAT=[124,126,127,129,147,149,176,232,234,279,308,326,372,374]
bg=np.array([frac(allc,p)[0] for p in range(111,410) if frac(allc,p)[1]>=60])
catf=np.array([frac(allc,p)[0] for p in CAT])
# permutation test: mean identity of the 14 catalytic positions vs random 14-position sets in the domain
pool=[p for p in range(111,410) if frac(allc,p)[1]>=60]
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=np.array([np.mean([frac(allc,p)[0] for p in rng.choice(pool,len(CAT),replace=False)]) for _ in range(20000)])
pval=(np.sum(null>=catf.mean())+1)/(len(null)+1)
print('\nDomain background (111-409, n>=60 aligned): mean %.3f  median %.3f  n=%d positions'%(bg.mean(),np.median(bg),len(bg)))
print('Catalytic set (14 positions): mean identity %.3f'%catf.mean())
print('Permutation test (20000 random 14-position sets): p = %.2e'%pval)
print('\nPer-kingdom identity at catalytic positions (fungi n=%d, bacteria n=%d):'%(len(fung),len(bact)))
print('pos aa  fungi%  bact%')
for p in CAT:
    print(f'{p:4d} {Q[p-1]}  {frac(colsF,p)[0]*100:5.1f}  {frac(colsB,p)[0]*100:5.1f}')

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(bg,bins=30,color='#9aa7b4',label='all domain positions (n=%d)'%len(bg))
for p,f in zip(CAT,catf): ax.axvline(f,color='#c0392b',lw=1.2,alpha=.8)
ax.axvline(catf.mean(),color='#7b241c',lw=3,label='mean of 14 catalytic positions')
ax.set_xlabel('fraction of 180 AIM6-family homologs with the same residue as Q6FWH9')
ax.set_ylabel('number of positions')
ax.set_title('Catalytic constellation is the most conserved\npart of the AIM6 domain (permutation p = %.1e)'%pval)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[1]
lbl=['H124','H126','N127','Y129','E147','D149','H176','D232','K234','T279','D308','S326','R372','W374']
x=np.arange(len(CAT))
ax.bar(x-0.2,[frac(colsF,p)[0]*100 for p in CAT],0.4,label='fungi (120 genera)',color='#2e86c1')
ax.bar(x+0.2,[frac(colsB,p)[0]*100 for p in CAT],0.4,label='bacteria (60 genera)',color='#e67e22')
ax.axhline(bg.mean()*100,ls='--',color='k',lw=1,label='domain background mean')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lbl,rotation=60); ax.set_ylabel('% identical to C. glabrata AIM6')
ax.set_title('Conservation across fungi and bacteria')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump({'pval':float(pval),'cat':dict(zip(CAT,catf.tolist())),'bg_mean':float(bg.mean())},open('/tmp/stat.json','w'))
